verdict.rationale: Scheduling recurring jobs is a fair question for an email-automation platform, but the evidence shows no recurring or cron-style trigger. Workflows are event- or trigger-driven with delays (bento-docs-46), and sequences are ordered emails with delays (bento-docs-43); both are adjacent features, not recurring schedules. Broadcast scheduling covers one-time sends only (bento-docs-34), and "script the job you run every week" (bento-docs-4) implies the user supplies the scheduling with their own tools, which is a workaround and earns no credit.
